description: A closing call to action with a large serif title, an accent word and one button under a field of stars.
docs:
The block takes its words as props; the types sit at the top of the file. Name the theme in the same command, for example: npx shadcn@latest add https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/midnight-theme.json https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/midnight-cta.json. A theme that only comes in as a dependency adds its colours but keeps your existing --background, --primary and fonts. If the page is not night-blue, run: npx shadcn@latest add https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/midnight-theme.json.
The full Midnight template, with seven more sections, forms and analytics: https://templates.vilqor.com/midnight?ref=shadcn
